data.content:
# Paris 2024 Olympics | Selfies, Eiffel Tower in the background, Zinédine Zidane in the grandstands: day three of the Champions Park in photos

On Thursday 1 August, the Champions Park of the Paris 2024 Olympic Games celebrated its third opening day. Set up to celebrate all the medallists in the competition, it once again lived up to expectations, offering magical moments in a picture-postcard setting between the Eiffel Tower and Place du Trocadéro. [...] PARIS, FRANCE - AUGUST 01: Men's Artistic Gymnastics gold medalist Wataru Tanigawa of Team Japan takes a selfie with fans on day six of the Olympic Games Paris 2024 at Champions Park on August 01, 2024 in Paris, France. (Photo by Arturo Holmes/Getty Images) [...] A show that once again lived up to expectations. Despite fears about the weather forecast, the Champions Park of the Paris 2024 Olympic Games held firm and was finally able to welcome the athletes and the public on Thursday 1 August. The thousands of spectators who flocked to the foot of the Eiffel Tower were able to cheer on some of the Olympic heroes.

data.label: PARIS UNVEIL NEW EIFFEL TOWER-INSPIRED 2024 OLYMPIC GAMES BID LOGO - Ficts
data.content:
The logo features the number 24 twisted into the shape of the Eiffel Tower, which is thought to reference the last time Paris hosted the Olympics in 1924, as well as their latest effort to host the Games in 2024.

Paris, which has previously hosted two Games, is competing against Budapest, Rome and Los Angeles for the 2024 Olympics.

The International Olympic Committee (IOC) will choose the host city in September 2017. [...] The Paris 2024 Olympic bid committee unveiled their new Eiffel Tower-inspired logo at a Ceremony in the French capital. The design, claimed to be a modern interpretation of the iconic landmark, was projected symbolically into the Arc de Triomphe in front of a crowd of spectators and city officials and simultaneously onto the town hall in Marseille.

data.label: Photos: Iconic Paris landmarks double up as Olympic venues | NBC Olympics
data.content:
A general view of the Eiffel Tower as the sun sets before a beach volleyball match during the 2024 Paris Olympics.

Andrew Nelles-USA TODAY Sports

THE GRAND PALAIS  
Unveiled in 1900 for the Paris Universal Exhibition, the Grand Palais is visible across swaths of Paris thanks to its sweeping glass roof. Paris 2024 fencing and taekwondo take place under its stunning nave.

A general view at the fencing competition during the 2024 Paris Olympics at Grand Palais. [...] Andrew P. Scott-USA TODAY Sports

INVALIDES  
A long stretch of lawn by the Seine that ends with the Hotel des Invalides, a 17th century complex of buildings that began life as a military hospital and also includes Napoleon's tomb, Invalides usually plays host to Parisians drinking wine or tossing a frisbee. During the Games, it hosts archery, road cycling and track events.

Hotel des Invalides viewed from the Eiffel Tower at the 2024 Paris Olympics.

Rob Schumacher-USA TODAY Sports [...] As sunny weather returns to France, the Paris Olympics are placing some of the capital's most famous landmarks center stage. Here is a look at where you can watch the sporting events:

EIFFEL TOWER  
The beach volleyball takes place against one of the most iconic backdrops in Olympics history, with the Eiffel Tower looming over the athletes as they compete in a temporary stadium built in the Champ de Mars park.

data.label: In pictures: Paris Olympics are a feast for the eyes as iconic venues take centre stage - France 24
data.content:
# In pictures: Paris Olympics are a feast for the eyes as iconic venues take centre stage

From our special correspondent - The sporting competitions at the Paris Olympic Games are being staged at some of France’s most emblematic locations: the Palace of Versailles, the former bastion of the French monarchy; the final resting place of Napoleon at Les Invalides; that most Parisian of monuments, the Eiffel Tower. Photographers have been happily capturing the spectacle. [...] The sporting line-up includes equestrian events at Versailles, fencing at the Grand Palais, beach volleyball at the Eiffel Tower, and breakdancing at the Place de la Concorde. The beauty of the city backdrop has provided an assist to photographers trying to capture iconic sporting moments.
